newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain very quiet in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain very quiet in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained very quiet this afternoon with only two nearby trades reported, market sources said.

"There was no fresh news to lure buyers into the market as most expected Chicago soymeal futures to ease further, which was confirmed by pre-opening calls for an easier CBOT soymeal futures opening," one dealer said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded $2 down at $261 a tonne cif Rotterdam and arrived Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $147 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
